answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can mirror deterministic failure containment by requiring each identity to post a bonded stake held in an escrow vault, so that reputation accrues only through verified work like nectar earned rather than claimed. Agents must forge a proof-of-personhood attestation chained to that stake, letting peers detect duplicate identities. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
